title: Roy Craig interview with Lewis Chase, who denies knowledge

tellings.quote: >> The following interview conducted by Roy Craig is with Lieutenant Colonel Lewis D. Chase, who is chief of the operations division at Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana.

plain: In 1967 an investigator named Roy Craig recorded an interview with Lieutenant Colonel Lewis D. Chase, chief of the operations division at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a nuclear missile base, and Chase denied knowing anything about the UFO events there. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer who says a UFO shut down ten nuclear missiles, plays the tape, which opens: "The following interview conducted by Roy Craig is with Lieutenant Colonel Lewis D. Chase." Salas brings it up because the denial sits against what he says happened.
